content.title: Page Character Breach | Drawing Crosses into Real Space and Counterpart Reacts
content.summary: A drawn meteorologist exits a weather atlas and exchanges a final look with the version still inside the storm panel. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One flat character, one physical room and one persistent carrier boundary are readable before any breach. + A visible action by the flat character causes one local opening in the same registered carrier. + Identity anchors remain traceable while the character crosses from drawn representation into a physical adult body. + The physical adult leaves the carrier, verifies the new state and deliberately reconnects attention to the unchanged opening. + The terminal frame proves both media states and a reciprocal counterpart reaction at the same boundary.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original foldout weather atlas on a brass reading stand in a pale observatory and show a drawn adult meteorologist with a silver braid, teal field coat and triangular amber badge inside one storm panel. Carry the same face, braid, coat and badge through the seam as a photoreal adult steps onto the observatory floor; keep the atlas, stand and ragged opening in frame. Hold a shared composition where the physical adult and her still-drawn counterpart meet the same gaze axis across the atlas, then let one ink cloud curl into the exact original mark "FORECAST OUTSIDE".
required_anchors: One flat character, one physical room and one persistent carrier boundary are readable before any breach.
A visible action by the flat character causes one local opening in the same registered carrier.
The physical adult leaves the carrier, verifies the new state and deliberately reconnects attention to the unchanged opening.
The terminal frame proves both media states and a reciprocal counterpart reaction at the same boundary.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A drawn meteorologist exits a weather atlas and exchanges a final look with the version still inside the storm panel. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先把平面角色、书页边界和现实房间同时建立，再让同一身份沿可见破口从绘制状态转为实体；实体离开页面后检查自身并回看原载体，终局让平面与现实两种版本互相反应，证明越界不是普通换镜。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One flat character, one physical room and one persistent carrier boundary are readable before any breach.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One flat character, one physical room and one persistent carrier boundary are readable before any breach."

invariants.rule: A visible action by the flat character causes one local opening in the same registered carrier.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A visible action by the flat character causes one local opening in the same registered carrier."

invariants.rule: Identity anchors remain traceable while the character crosses from drawn representation into a physical adult body.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Identity anchors remain traceable while the character crosses from drawn representation into a physical adult body."

invariants.rule: The physical adult leaves the carrier, verifies the new state and deliberately reconnects attention to the unchanged opening.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The physical adult leaves the carrier, verifies the new state and deliberately reconnects attention to the unchanged opening."

invariants.rule: The terminal frame proves both media states and a reciprocal counterpart reaction at the same boundary.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal frame proves both media states and a reciprocal counterpart reaction at the same boundary."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
